name: CloudMoon
requires: Nothing: CloudMoon's free play time as a guest, or your own CloudMoon account
pitch: Mobile games from the cloud, on your PS3.
description: Play the mobile games CloudMoon streams from cloud Android phones (Roblox, Genshin Impact and more) on your PS3: as a guest with CloudMoon's free play time, or signed in with your own CloudMoon account from your phone. The controller plays each game on its own layout (L3 + R3 for a pointer), and a USB keyboard and mouse play as on CloudMoon's website. Not made by or affiliated with CloudMoon.
whatsNew: Games play now, on DeepPlay's stream screen. Sign in with your own CloudMoon account (scan the QR code on the Account tab). The controller plays on each game's layout; L3 + R3 switches to a pointer. USB keyboard and mouse supported. Pick CloudMoon's server in Settings, Plugins, CloudMoon.
